routes.name: ARROW
routes.shape: From outside the corner, stem inside on a slight angle to 5; from inside the corner, push straight up to 5. Turn over the inside shoulder, settle and face the QB.
vs: Man: break back out and separate.
Pressure on your side: get your eyes to the QB right away.

routes.name: ATTACK
routes.shape: Inside release and aim the first angle at the Mike, reaching 10 yards.
vs: Tampa 2: take the Mike's spot.
Not Tampa 2: stay between the hashes.
2 Man: break away from your defender.

routes.name: BASIC
routes.shape: Push vertical to 12 to 14 and keep moving. From a +2 split, start with a slant burst 5 up and 2 to 3 in, then push vertical.

routes.name: BLAZER
routes.shape: Aim at the outside edge of the numbers, then at 20 get thin past the DB to the inside edge of the numbers. If the DB will not widen, go around him. The ball comes between the hash and the numbers.

routes.name: BENCH
routes.shape: Sell a go for at least 15, plant on the inside foot and speed cut out at 20. From width, slant-burst release for 5, then get vertical to 15 and cut.
vs: Trail technique: set the route higher.

routes.name: SHORT BENCH
routes.shape: Attack the DB's leverage for 10 and speed cut out. From width, use a slant-burst release.
vs: Cloud: straight stem.
Trail technique: set it higher.

routes.name: BACK
routes.shape: Red zone route. From full width, inside release and push vertical, leaving 2 yards from the back endline, then double up and break to the back pylon. From a tight split, widen the release first.

routes.name: BOBCAT
routes.shape: Red zone route. Sell a widen fade, get 5 into the end zone, then snap down and come back to the front pylon. A short widen Puma.

routes.name: BLINK
routes.shape: Run a Blazer, plant and turn in at 20, then keep working back toward the QB.

routes.name: BLAZE OUT
routes.shape: Run a Blazer, run through 20, then break down at 90 degrees between 22 and 25.

routes.name: BRANCH
routes.shape: A Stick run at 10 yards. If detached, lose 2 on the release before pushing vertical.
vs: Man: run it out.
Zone: throttle.

routes.name: CHOICE
routes.shape: Pause a count at the line, push to 5, then a three-way go. Press the out and fall into the in-break.
vs: Zone: find the soft spot.
Man: run away from the defender.
If the nickel disappears, work the outermost defender.

routes.name: CLEAR
routes.shape: A locked seam with no read, landmark the inside edge of the numbers.

routes.name: C.O.
routes.shape: A choice route decided ahead of time to break out: push vertical to 5 and break out. From a stack, arc release chasing the near receiver's outside hip.

routes.name: COIN
routes.shape: A two-option choice: push vertical to 5, then sit or break out.
vs: Zone: sit and turn over the inside shoulder.
Man: break out.

routes.name: COMEBACK
routes.shape: Sell a go to 18, plant and break out at 45 degrees working downhill. Attack the ball and beat the defender back to it.
vs: Cloud: convert to a fade.

routes.name: CORNER
routes.shape: Best release, vertical to 12, then angle toward the sideline to reach 22.
vs: Man or coverage on top: flatten.
If you beat the corner at the line and he trails, take a higher angle to score.

routes.name: CURL
routes.shape: Sell a go to 15, plant and turn in, then keep working back toward the QB.
vs: Press man: best release.
Cloud: widen and slip inside the corner.

routes.name: DAGGER
routes.shape: Sell a go for 18, plant the outside foot and roll flat to 20 between the numbers and the hash. Works from full width or a tight split.
vs: Pressed: can square it off at 18.

routes.name: DEEP SIT
routes.shape: Take a 45 degree angle inside and hold it to 10 to 12 yards directly over the ball.
vs: If the QB gives you eyes with a defender attached, break flat back to the side you started on.

routes.name: DART
routes.shape: Run an Arrow. At the top, jab as if returning, then burst across the flat at 5.
vs: Dart Read: run the Arrow and sit against zone; if matched, jab and burst across the defender's face.

routes.name: DOWN FLAT
routes.shape: In-line. Cut off the C gap defender and get your head in front without slowing, so it feels like a run block. Late version: not the hot throw because a Slide carries the hot. Hot version: against edge pressure, abort the cutoff and get the head around at once for the QB.
vs: Edge pressure (Hot version): abort the cutoff and give the QB an outlet.

routes.name: DIAGONAL
routes.shape: Set the first angle at the near high safety, work over the top of the Mike and break to daylight. Drawn with the Special label.
vs: Man: flatten and run away.

routes.name: FADE
routes.shape: Red zone. Work the release at the line, then track the ball to the back pylon when the QB is in the gun. Run to win and react to an opportunity throw.

routes.name: FIELD POST
routes.shape: King split. Start a Read stem to 15, plant and break across the field with speed to daylight.

routes.name: FAULK
routes.shape: Widen slightly on the release to sell the seam and get the defender running, then break on 5 steps. Depth matters for timing. Can go over the top against hard inside leverage, but the aim is to win inside. Be decisive.
vs: Hard inside leverage: can go over the top.

routes.name: FAR CORNER
routes.shape: Gaining-angle stem for 16, then aim at the far pylon. Run on the backside of keepers.

routes.name: FAULK T.O.
routes.shape: Same start as Faulk. Break on the Faulk for 1 to 3 steps, then work the release to widen back outside and win.

routes.name: FLAG
routes.shape: From width, stem inside, push vertical to 10 and roll out to 15. From the tight end spot, best release, then the same.

routes.name: FLAT
routes.shape: Outside release on an angle that gains 2 to 3 yards of depth toward the sideline. No break point: take a good angle, gain width and depth, get the head around fast. The QB can flatten it.

routes.name: GO
routes.shape: Run vertical as fast as possible. Against a stacked defender, leave the red line for the QB. Avoid being rerouted. Separate, then locate the ball.

routes.name: GLANCE
routes.shape: Push vertical for 5 steps (3 big, 2 little) and break inside at 45 degrees, or flatter if needed.

routes.name: FLAT CHINA
routes.shape: Sell a flat route, then plant and burst back flat inside. To the field, sell it to the outside edge of the numbers; to the boundary, to 2 yards outside the numbers.

routes.name: HIGH CROSS
routes.shape: Inside release, angle to 8 to 10, push vertical, then break across the field to 18 to 22 between the hash and the numbers.
vs: Man: flatten and run away.

routes.name: HIGH CORNER
routes.shape: Slant-burst release to 5 looking like a run block, to protect the keeper game. Get vertical to 15, speed cut and roll to 18 to 20.
vs: DB trailing on the outside hip: take a higher angle.

routes.name: HIGH SHALLOW CROSS
routes.shape: Inside release climbing to 7 while reading coverage. Paired with a Low Shallow Cross from the other side; this route sets the depth for the rub.
vs: Man: keep moving and look at the QB.
Zone: sit no sooner than the backside ghost tight end and give the QB your eyes.

routes.name: JO
routes.shape: Run at the inside linebacker, stutter the feet and break vertical.

routes.name: LOW CROSS
routes.shape: Get into the QB's vision fast. Outside release, shoulder through at the second level and cross at 10 to 12. Run on the backside of keepers.

routes.name: LOCK
routes.shape: King split. The Read route with no read: always sit it down.

routes.name: LOCKER
routes.shape: King split. Read stem to 20, then plant and break flat across.

routes.name: LIGHTNING
routes.shape: Sell a go for 10, plant the outside foot, turn in and work back down the stem. Get the depth. A short hinge.
vs: Cloud: fade.

routes.name: LOOKIE
routes.shape: A Choice route on a vertical stem, run at a faster tempo.

routes.name: MONEY
routes.shape: A two-option choice: push vertical to 5, then sit or break in.
vs: Zone: sit and turn over the inside shoulder.
Man: break in.

routes.name: NOW
routes.shape: Take one step and angle underneath the second-level defenders. Stay on the move.

routes.name: OMAHA
routes.shape: Sell a go for 4 steps, plant on the inside foot, run an out and get the head and shoulders around. Speed cut whether inside or outside the numbers. Split to the outside edge of the numbers.
vs: Press: run the Omaha.
Cloud: fade.

routes.name: OVER
routes.shape: Inside release and sit over the ball at 5. When the QB gives eye contact, slide back where you came from to give him a throw.

routes.name: OTB
routes.shape: An Over that stays static, used when you are the Over in the Spacing or Stick concept.

routes.name: OPTION
routes.shape: Inside release to 5 over the ball with a three-way go. Be decisive and do not let the defender grab you.
vs: Coverage vacates: sit over the ball and flash the hands.
Covered: work back where you came from, or jab and cross the defender's face.

routes.name: OMAHA T.O.
routes.shape: Double move. Run the Omaha, plant on the inside foot and turn up the sideline, avoiding contact.
vs: Press man: run it.
Cloud: fade.

routes.name: OMAHA CHINA
routes.shape: Complement to the Flag. Sell a widen Omaha for 4 steps on the speed cut, run 4 more steps to the landmark (field: outside edge of the numbers; boundary: 2 outside the numbers), then plant and come back inside flat.

routes.name: POST
routes.shape: Sell a go to 18, plant and aim at the near upright. The QB can flatten it. Separate, then locate.
vs: Stays on against every coverage.

routes.name: PRESSURE
routes.shape: Push vertical to 10, plant and speed cut out to 12. Attack leverage and win outside; the ball is completed on the sideline.

routes.name: POINT
routes.depth: 5 yards, or 2 across the goal line
routes.shape: Run on the Point concept. Outside release and push vertical to 5, or 2 yards past the goal line. The inside receiver uses the natural pick to get open.

routes.name: PIVOT
routes.shape: Work up to 5 and turn inside.

routes.name: PYLON
routes.shape: King split. Look like a Read, then at 15 take a high angle to the near or back pylon.

routes.name: PUMA
routes.shape: Sell a go to 15, plant on the inside foot and break out at 45 degrees downhill. Attack the ball and beat the defender to it.
vs: Cloud: fade adjust.

routes.name: PUSH
routes.shape: Run through the near shoulder of the near high safety to clear coverage.

routes.name: PYLON POST
routes.shape: King split. Look like a Read, at 15 lean out for 3 steps as if running Pylon, then angle to the near upright.

routes.name: RACE PIVOT
routes.shape: Work up to 1 yard across the goal line and turn inside.
vs: Man or tight zone: work away from the defender.

routes.name: RACE
routes.shape: Red zone. From full width, inside release and push vertical, leaving 2 yards from the back endline, then speed cut. From a tight split, widen the release first.

routes.name: RAIL
routes.shape: A go route from inside the numbers. Gain width and depth to the red line.

routes.name: RUNBACK
routes.shape: A 20 yard comeback that converts to a sit at 15 against cloud.
vs: Cloud: outside release and sit on the sideline at 15.

routes.name: READ T.O.
routes.shape: The Read route with no sit: give the safety a slight stutter at 15 and run vertical. Do not break down; stay vertical and let the QB bring you inside.

routes.name: SCOUT
routes.shape: A widen 6 step speed out with the inside foot up in the stance. Attack 2 yards outside the original alignment.
vs: Cloud: fade.

routes.name: SEAM
routes.shape: Seam or preferred outside release to the inside edge of the numbers. Push vertical and look for the ball once past the underneath coverage.
vs: Two safeties: bend at 10 to 12, tight off the second-level defender, and break to daylight; you must cross his face.

routes.name: SEAM STOP
routes.shape: Seam landmarks, but sit at 15 turning over the inside shoulder.

routes.name: SAIL
routes.shape: Preferred inside release on the curl-flat player, stem vertical to 12, plant on the inside foot and set a high angle out expecting the ball.
vs: Defender high: the QB flattens you with the throw.

routes.name: SCOUT T.O.
routes.shape: Run the Scout, come out of the break for 3 steps, then win on a second speed cut.
vs: Cloud: fade.

routes.name: SEARCH
routes.shape: Inside release and aim the first angle at the Mike, reaching 15. The deeper Attack.
vs: Tampa 2: take the Mike's spot.
Not Tampa 2: stay between the hashes.
2 Man: break away from your defender.

routes.name: SKINNY
routes.shape: A Strike on a straight stem. Push 7 steps, plant and cross the defender's face as flat as needed. Expect the ball out of the break.

routes.name: SHAKE
routes.shape: Run a Glance, sell it for 5 steps, then come out at an angle to cross the DB's face.

routes.name: SHALLOW CROSS
routes.shape: Inside release on a sharp angle through the heels of the end, climbing to 5 while reading coverage. Possible hot throw.
vs: Zone: sit no sooner than the backside ghost tight end, give the QB your eyes, green grass rule.
Man: keep moving and look at the QB to show you want the ball.

routes.name: SHORT CROSS
routes.shape: Shallow Cross rules, with the option to sit over the ball.
vs: Zone: can sit over the ball.

routes.name: SHORT HOOK
routes.shape: Best release, 8 yards, turn over the inside shoulder. Landmark: field, between the numbers and the hash; boundary, 1 yard inside the numbers.

routes.name: SMASH
routes.shape: From full width, push to 6, 1 yard outside your alignment, turn in and stay static.

routes.name: SLIDE
routes.shape: Keeper route. Start on the fake side and slide behind the line to the other side of the formation, finding the best way past the backside end or outside backer. First in the progression and the hot.

routes.name: SLANT
routes.shape: Sell a go for 3 steps and break inside at 45 degrees.
vs: Press man: best release, push to 5 and cross the defender's face.
Cloud, press and quarters: get the full 5 and flatten the angle.

routes.name: SLUGGO
routes.shape: Double move off the Slant, avoiding contact. Three steps, three steps, go, unless the defender is aggressive.
vs: Press man: outside release, one hard step to the slant, then go.

routes.name: SLUGGO PUMA
routes.shape: Sell the Sluggo, then break at 15 on a 45 degree angle and run a Puma.

routes.name: SNAG
routes.shape: Sell a Shallow Cross, then break down and explode back out. Come out running, ready to sit.
vs: Man: sell it all the way to the playside A gap.
Zone: sell it less and be ready to sit.

routes.name: STICK
routes.shape: Release vertical at the first defender off the ball or head up, break at 5 and come out flat, thinking man and reacting to zone. Head around quick, expecting the ball out of the break. With a flat route inside you, lose 2 on the stick to keep spacing.

routes.name: STICK NOD
routes.shape: Run the Stick, break at 5 for a few steps with the head back to invite the undercut, then work downfield. The exit angle depends on the defender's leverage.
vs: Single safety: stay thin.
Two safeties: cross his face.

routes.name: STICK CHINA
routes.shape: Run the Stick, run a full 4 steps out of the break looking hot, then break down and burst back inside.

routes.name: SPOT
routes.shape: Take a 45 degree angle inside to 5 and sit static. Cross the first defender's face and sit. Do not let the split give the route away.

routes.name: SPECIAL
routes.shape: Set the first angle at the near high safety and work over the top of the Mike to daylight. Around 8 yards decide whether to go over the top or cross his face.
vs: One safety vs two safeties changes the finish, as drawn.

routes.name: STORK
routes.shape: Uncover at the line of scrimmage and show the QB your numbers.

routes.name: STREAK
routes.shape: King split. Read stem toward the near upright, taking the top off the defense.

routes.name: STRIKE
routes.shape: 7 steps, 2 yards outside your alignment, breaking at an angle to the hole in the defense. Catch it just outside the hash. Normal width is a straight stem.
vs: Bump: get 10 yards.
Hard inside leverage: straighten the stem.
Cover 2: use a slip technique.

routes.name: STOMP
routes.shape: A go from the slot. Best release and angle to the imaginary red line as fast as possible.

routes.name: STOMP PUMA
routes.shape: Stomp release into a Puma to win. Work for width and depth to the numbers at 15. No conversion.

routes.name: STROKE
routes.shape: 8 steps, 2 yards outside your alignment, then a speed cut to the sideline.
vs: Bump: get 10 yards.

routes.name: SWIRL
routes.shape: Sell the Corner: push to 10, break to the corner to 15, then plant and work straight back to the QB. Push to the inside edge of the numbers.

routes.name: THUNDER
routes.shape: Sell a go to 6, turn and show the QB your numbers. Do not come up short. With free access, 3 big steps and 2 little.
vs: Press man: convert to a Stop (sell a go to 8, turn in, come straight back down the stem, ball on the outside shoulder).

routes.name: THROTTLE
routes.shape: Sell the High Cross to 12, burst to 15 and get to the near hash.
vs: Safety cutting you or you are covered: sit, then uncover.
No safety cutting you: sit.

routes.name: T.O.
routes.shape: Takeoff, usually on a keeper or play pass. Push vertical to 15, drop the weight as if running a Puma, be patient, then take off. There is time to sell it.
vs: Cloud: sit briefly on the sideline at 15, then burst.

routes.name: THUNDER T.O.
routes.shape: Sell a go to 6, drop the weight as if running a Thunder, then accelerate with a plan to win.
vs: Cloud: fade.

routes.name: UNDER
routes.shape: Sell a go to 5, plant and come inside staying flat. Do not settle; never get deeper than 5.

routes.name: UNDER T.O.
routes.shape: Run the Under at 5, beat the corner outside and widen back out to stay away from the safety.

routes.name: UNDER RETURN
routes.shape: Push to 5, plant the outside foot and sell the Under for at least 2 steps, then snap down, transition and run away from the defender. Be patient with the sell.

routes.name: WIDEN GO
routes.shape: From a reduced split, widen to the red line with width and depth and be ready for a throw downfield.
vs: Zone: this route clears the deep coverage.

routes.name: WIDEN CURL
routes.shape: Sell a go to 15, plant, turn in and keep working back to the QB. Landmark: field, the middle of the numbers; boundary, the outside edge of the numbers.

routes.name: WHIRL
routes.depth: Save 2 to 3 from the back endline
routes.shape: Red zone. Outside release on the DB, hold 2 to 3 yards from the back endline and sell a Race, then pull out flat to the back pylon. Usually late in the progression, so there is time to sell it.

routes.name: CHECK THRU
routes.depth: 3 yards on quick game, 5 on longer drops
routes.shape: Check protection, go downhill through the line and look over the inside shoulder for the dump-off over the ball. Find the open area at 3 on quick game; past a 3 step drop, get to 5.

routes.name: CHECK WIDE
routes.shape: Check protection, lose 2 under control and get width. Stay wide until outside the numbers; the ball brings you downhill. Catch it at or behind the line and keep running for width. With a free release, do not lose ground from home.

routes.name: CHECK FLAT
routes.shape: Check protection, release outside toward the sideline looking over the outside shoulder for a ball 3 to 5 deep. If no ball by 5 yards from the sideline, settle. In Scat, alert hot.

routes.name: CHECK SLOW
routes.shape: Check protection, get 2 by 2 outside the end man on the line (weak or strong) and turn outside. With the ball on the near hash, landmark the inside edge of the numbers.
vs: Man: break away from the defender outside when the QB gives you eyes.

routes.name: CHECK BURST
routes.depth: 1 to 2 yards through the line, catch at 5
routes.shape: Check protection, release inside through the line 1 to 2 deep and deepen as you cross the ball so the catch comes at 5. The angle matters. Catch and get upfield.
vs: Man: win with no depth.
Zone: sit.

routes.name: CHECK OPTION
routes.shape: Check protection, release quickly through the line to 5 and read the defender in front of you.
vs: Zone: sit over the ball in the open area.
Man: beat the defender inside or outside and stay on the move.

routes.name: SCREEN ROUTE
routes.shape: Key the guard, take the best release and get to a landmark 4 by 4 from the tackle. Catch the screen on the move and stay inside the numbers. Slam the onside blitzer and invite him inside.
vs: Two blitzers: bluff the inside one.

routes.name: CHOICE (HB)
routes.shape: Free release outside on a vertical stem to 2 to 4 and read the defender in front of you.
vs: Zone: sit in the open area.
Man: beat him inside or outside at 45 degrees and stay on the move.
Hot: run a flat route and get the head around fast.

routes.name: COIN (HB)
routes.shape: Release outside on a vertical stem to 2 to 4 and read the defender in front of you.
vs: Zone: sit in the open area.
Man: beat him outside and stay on the move.
Hot: run a flat route and get the head around fast.

routes.name: RAIL (HB)
routes.shape: Full speed at the outside stem of the receiver or the numbers, finishing 30 yards upfield and 5 from the sideline.
vs: Defender over the top: alert for the back-shoulder throw.

routes.name: C.O. (HB)
routes.shape: Release outside on a vertical stem to 2 to 4 and break out. A choice route decided ahead of time to go out.
vs: Hot: run a flat route and get the head around fast.
